en: The postcard features a black and white reproduction of an old painting depicting a biblical or allegorical scene, with many people engaged in various activities on a vineyard-covered hill. There are groups of people at the bottom, a well, and figures working in the vineyard above. The image is accompanied by German text printed on the right, identifying the artwork and its location.
